description.value: Cedar Song B&B and Cottage is a custom-built cedar home on 5 forested acres in Errington, between Qualicum Beach and Parksville on central Vancouver Island, offering two en-suite guest rooms and a fully self-contained 1,100 sq ft cottage. Host Anneke Van Vugt is an experienced tour operator and longtime tour guide, well placed to advise guests on the surrounding region. The property sits near hiking trails and the Englishman River, making it a peaceful rural base for cyclists touring the central Island corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and corroborates the OSM name, phone, and street address; the full mailing address including Errington, BC V0R 1V0 is confirmed on the contact page. Laundry and Wi-Fi are explicitly stated on the guest rooms and cottage pages. The website contains no mention of bicycle storage, cycling procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific infrastructure, so both required criteria remain null.
concerns: The 2BR Cottage is listed as 'Not available till further notice' on the rates page, suggesting reduced capacity.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, wash station, tools) are mentioned anywhere on the website despite the property being oriented toward active outdoor guests.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active B&B in a cycling-friendly corridor with a tour-operator host, but the website makes no mention of secure bike storage or any cycling-specific amenities — the primary required criterion cannot be confirmed without direct outreach.

Laundry.detail: Guest rooms page states 'Laundry services available'; the cottage has its own washer and dryer

wow_evidence: custom-built cedar home on 5 forested acres in Errington
